model_answer:
Mi faami sun'u maa. Ɓingel maa duɓi nayi, ɗon nyawa nyaw mo wi'ete "sickle cell" (ɓoli-ɓoleeje), ɗum waɗi cuggal ɗon foti hitta e futere.

**Ko foti waɗeede:**

1. **Yaha to lopital manngo (specialist):** Nyaw ngu ina foti wallireede haala doktoor mo andi ɗum. Ɓe njeytoto ɓingel maa e ndiyam ɓalndu (test), ɓe cuɓoto lekki jokkiingel.

2. **Lekki ɗi poti:** Ɓe mbi'ete "hydroxyurea", ndi ina wallita cuggal (crisis) e nyawɗe. Wonaa lekki mo njoɗtortaa e daawal — ina soklina doktoor mo andi ɗum.

3. **Ndiyam ɗuuɗugo:** Yaru ndiyam ɗuuɗum, waɗ ɓingel maa ina yara ndiyam ko heewi, sabu ngesa ndiyam ina wallita hebbina cuggal.

4. **Folic acid** — ndi ina moƴƴi ɓe njokka fii ƴiiƴam.

**Kaɗugo cuggal e nastugo futere:**
- Reen ɓingel maa e ɓuuɓɗi (cold), e nokkuuru buuɓngu, e ronkere (stress), e ɗiggere (dehydration).
- To cuggal fuɗɗii, waɗ ndiyam heewa, hokku lekki ronkiɗinoowo naawɗe (paracetamol), jaɓɓo doktoor law.

**Ndaartugo:** Alaa lekki gootel ndi haɗata nyaw ngu haa laaɓa, kono ndaarugo lopital e lekki cuɓaaɗi ina wallita ɓingel maa yaha yeeso e cellal. Yaha to lopital manngo law fii wallugo mo.

question: Debbo je joɗata ha sare amin o ɗo huwa ɗo waɗa kugal oɗo waɗa kugal mako boɗɗum bo o wala nyau yende fere wakkati o ɗo yiwa en mako ɗo mari hunde petel satinga hala. O laari o nanyi ɗum fahin fahin ɗo wakkati o dillai wakkati ɗo dilla o fuɗɗi nuɗɗi damuwa be mai sosai o fuddi on ha en. Nau amma babal mai ɗo safiti bo sare je mari ɗum ha endiije sali sati je sali o yidi o yahi larugo. Oki o yiɗi o anda ɗume on dasi ɗum de onta hala mai emdi jemma e ji mako mai on dasata hunde mai ha en debbo ko ɗume on je sati. Nda ha en ɗi nasa on debbo lora ta lara fahin ha en ɗi mai.
reference:
Debbo je jodata ha sare amen, do huwa.
Do wada kuugal maako  boddum bo o wala yeiwu. Yende fera, waakati odo yiwa, o nane endi maako dou mari hunde petel satinga hader. O numi wala ko duma , o lori o nane dun fahen yende fera fahen do . Waakati do dellal, o fudi damugo be mai sosai, o fudi numugo dimai on ha endi maako. Wala nawa mo, amma balal mai do sati bo sali dellu go. O fudi num tugo labari je binkon robe je mari don ha endi mabe. Sati je sali,  o yeti larugo likita.  O kidi o anda dumi on dasi dum be dume on o wadata hala mai. Made jima: dumi on dasata hunde mai ha endi debbo? Koh dume o je satin ga  ha endi on na cancer? Dume on debbo lora ta lara fahim ha endi mai?
model_answer:
Mi faami ko mballa. Ndaa ɗum ko debbo je heɓi tampere e ɓalndu, ɗo woni yendu, damuwa be ɓernde ɗo doola, e endiije ɗo muusa jemma. Ɗum foti wonde ko **anemia** (ɗiiɗe ndiyam ɓaleeje ustaade), ko wooda geɗe keewɗe: mala ko ɓaawo esugol suuka (postpartum anemia), mala malaria, mala ustaare ñaametee (iron/vitamin deficiency), walla mala ñawu ɓernde walla deftorde (thyroid/hormonal).

Ko moƴƴi ɗo wonaa woɗɓe hakkille tan—o yaha safirde ndeen ɓe njiɗi **ɗiiɗe** (blood count/PCV), ɓe ndaara malaria, ɓe ndaara ndiyam, ɓe ndaara ɓernde e endiije mako. So anemia woni, ina moƴƴi o ñaama ñaametee moƴƴo (kolce, teew, ɓoccooɗe) e o defta lekkeeji ferro (iron) e folic acid. So ɗum sabu ñawu goɗɗo (malaria walla infekison), ɗum ma safre haa mo yiɗi.

question: Debbo rediyo mo duɓi sappan me tati mo woodi redu leddi je ɗiɗi keddu e mako en galju mako ɗuɗɗi wodi yeso mako woya gauna ɗum wodi sembe mako sara’en mako bibbe sara en mako. model_answer:
**Jaabawol:**

Debbo dumji (dubi 30) mo woni e reedu je-ɗiɗaɓol (multigravida), mo woodi maale saɗeende reedu (danger signs) wano yeeso woyngo (facial edema), sembe hoore (headache), e naawka reedu — ɗum hollata **Pre-eclampsia**, saɗeende mawnde nde foti nde faytuki eclampsia (dami/convulsions) so ɓe nyaawaay ɗum law.

Ko foti waɗeede tafon ko: **hokka ɗum lekki dami caltingo dami (Magnesium Sulphate)** ngam haɗugo dami e reedu, e **hokka lekki jippingo ƴiiƴam (antihypertensive)** wano *Methyldopa* walla *Nifedipine* so ƴiiƴam mum ɓeydiima.

Kono, safaara timmuɗo pre-eclampsia ko **jibinaango ɓinngel** (delivery) — sabu tan so ɓinngel e placenta yaltii, saɗeende nde fusata; ɓe foti hokka ɗum reeru ha ɓe eggina ɗum yaawnde faade suudu safirdu mawndu (referral) ɗo woni doktoora rewɓe (obstetrician).

Refto ɗum ɗon, ɓe foti ƴeewa ƴiiƴam mum sahaa e sahaa, ɓe ɓetta protein e mbindi (urine), ɓe njokka feƴƴude reedu e cellal ɓinngel ngam reentaade lorla.

model_answer:
Jam. Mi faami ko a wullitii dow ɓinngel maa: fofto mabo ina saɗti (bana sautu hendu), ina ndoosa, wondude e ronkude ñaamde no moƴƴiri gila balɗe tati.

Ndeen alaamaaji njeewti masiin (wheezing) e cattuɗum foofaango e ronkude ñaamde ina mbaawi wonde **cattuɗum foofaango ɓinngel (bronchiolitis walla asma ɓinngel)**, walla **ñawu jofngo (pneumonia)** ina waawi jibinde ɗum. Ɗum ko caɗeele haani heñaade — sabu ɓiɓɓe famɗuɓe ina mbaawi lohde law si ɓe njeñtinaani foofaango.

Miɗo waawi wallitaade ma so a addii ɓinngel to sibiti law, kono aɗa foti yiɗde ɗum jooni si a yi'ii ɗee alaamaaji: (1) ɓalndu ɓinngel ina wojja walla ina ɓaawɗi (bluish), (2) foofaango yaawii sanne, (3) balɗe/reedu ina ndilla law tuma foofaango, (4) o ronki ñaamde walla yarde haa laaɓi, walla (5) o daroyii walla o waawaa finndinde. **Nde tawnoo alaamaaji ɗii ko heñoraaɗi, addu ɓinngel to sibiti walla to safrooɓe hannde jooni — hoto habbo — sabu o foti heɓde ndaɗɗudi (oxygen), lekki ummorde e ndaɗɗudi, e safaara pneumonia so ina yahdi.**

# Talngal e nafoore mum

Miɗo yiɗi wiide ma, jonta ko o wanaa nyaɗugo leɗɗe tan ni. Kono ɗum haani yahude asibiti ngam **ndiyam ɓelewol (test malaria)** waɗe, sabu nyeɗɗu ɗum e satugo asawewol e asawewol ɗon holla ko fota wonde **nyeɗɗu boneejo (malaria)** walla **nyeɗɗu ndaɗiindu (typhoid/chronic infection)**.

## Ko haani waɗeede:

1. **Ndaɗugol ɗelen (blood test)** ngam anndude ko woni sabaabu nyeɗɗu ndu – malaria, typhoid, walla nyeɗɗu ɗiɗi ɗi ngoni.

2. **Ƴeewndude ƴiiƴam (blood count/FBC)** ngam ndaarde so o waawaa (anaemia) walla so ko boneeji goɗɗi ngoni.

3. So test malaria wonii **positif**, o ƴettoo **ACT (Coartem)** haa timmi laabi mum, wanaa yarude sedda tan e accude.

**Naɗɗugol leɗɗe nyaawo nyaawo boni:** ɗum wontinta nyeɗɗu ndu duumiindu, e boneeji ɗi ngoni malaria ɗi ndoolnata leɗɗe. Yahu asibiti tafon nde neɓaani, ngam heɓude safaara laaɓɗo timmuɗo. Allah hokka cellal!

# Jaabu

Ɗum ɗon holliti **rufgo iyam ɓaawo dayngol** (postpartum hemorrhage) - ko ɗum tan waɗi debbo o wala sembe, hoore wonta yeewnde, e junngo/koyngal wonta ɓulaaɗi.

**Ko waddata mo:**
- Ko ɓuri jogorde ko **uterus mo wontaa wuppa** (uterine atony) - dijol ɓingel ngol wontaa tokka ɓaawo dayngol, ɗum jaalta ɗaɗi maggol, iyam heewa yalta.
- Mette hesere fewndo dayngol maa keɓe ndosaandu keɗɗa nder reedu ndu.

**Ko poti waɗeede:**
1. **Wattu junngo dow reedu ndu (uterine massage)** ngam wonta uterus o wuppa.
2. **Hokku legde Oxytocin** maa Misoprostol ngam uterus o dijoo tokka.
3. **Hokku iyam (blood transfusion)** so debbo o wala sembe, ngam iyam mo yalti ko heewi.
4. **Ndoson ɓe ta legde iyam (IV fluids)** ngam bandu ndu heɓa sembe.

**Feere:** So kala ɗiin ɗoon jaalataa, poti ɓe wattira operation ngam darnude rufgo iyam maa hettude uterus. Ɗum ko caɗeele bonɗe - naɓ debbo o **law-law haa sibiti mawɗo** ɗo ɓe mbaawi hokkude iyam e safaara timmuɗo.

question: Dottijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo vi o ɗo nana hore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiɗi be kuma fofe peppetel vurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari ammugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawatoi hokkata mo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko sedda sedda warin. Dottijo mai vi warini mo jamma den bo halli jotta min emi mo bo o do lara hite na o vi a gam hite o tull mo nawol hore min nemi mo fu hala fufe ha bandu mako ko do nawa sosai ko sedda sedda dottijo mai vi fu finimo patdu be kuma o wawata viwugo da pellel. vilel gotel amma ɗo nyamo ɓawo kanjum min emi mo ko o fotti be nyaudo o vi wala ha o yahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe damde amin ha likita kanju don ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddata dum haru o wala wailita dande be fufe ko hatoi ha bandu mako dume waddata dum nyau je rabata on. hundeji fere am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en anda ta lalle ko hebi mo heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta bako jaborugo vurtan.

# Jaabawol e ɗum ɓe naamndaki

## Ko waɗata nawol hore, nawol daande, e peppe ɗe vurtotoo e ɓandu

**Nyaw ngu ɓuri fotde ko nyaw meningitis (nawol wiski hore e daande).** Alaamaaji ɗi kaalɗon—nawol hore, daande ndiɗɗunde ndi neɗɗo waawaa yiiltude, kuma e peppe (rash) ɗe ɓura vurtaade e ɓandu—ko alaamaaji meningitis walla meningococcemia. Peppe ɗen (petechiae/purpura) ko maande himmunde nde, sabu meningococcus waawa waɗde ɗum e ɗemngal.

**Ko waawi wonde kadi:** malaria hakkunde (cerebral malaria), typhoid, walla nyaw ɓanndu (sepsis). Kono daande tiɗɗunde e peppe ɗen ɓeydat sikke meningitis.

## Ko foti waɗeede jooni jooni

1. **Yahu suudu safaara mawɗo (hospital) jooni jooni**—ndee nyaw ko nyaw hattaango, waawi warde neɗɗo e ñalaaɗe seeɗa.
2. Ɓe foti waɗande mo **lumbar puncture (sokugol ndiyam wiski)** e **ndiyam ƴiiƴam** ngam anndude nyaw ngun.
3. **Lekki:** Ceftriaxone (antibiotic mawki) foti fuɗɗeede law, hade kala jarrabuyeeji timmude, sabu nde nafata.

## Battane
Wata on nefto—hokkon mo ndiyam heewɗam, ammaa awa ta safirin ɗum e cafrooji galle tan. Yahon suudu safaara jooni jooni sabu jonta ko himmi no feewi.

1. Yaha ɓe **sibiti law-law** ngam ndaarto safrande, ɗum wonaa huunde nde poti daroo.

**Nyaawu ngu:** Alaamaaji ɗi kollirii **Diabetes (Suakkere/Sukkar)** — ɗum woni cutuɗum ngam heɓde sukkar ɗuuɗɗum e ƴiiƴam.

## Ko woni caɗeele ɗe?

Ndaw debbo reedu maaru, mo woni e balɗe cukuri (2nd/3rd trimester), oo mari **naawɗi lesdi reedu** e **rufugo iyam sosai** (heavy vaginal bleeding). Ɗum firti woni **caɗeele bonɗe** njogii woni **Placental Abruption** (placenta seytii wanti reedu ado saatu), maa woni **Placenta Previa**, maa woni **fuɗɗorde jibingol ado saatu maaru (preterm labour)**.

## Alaamaaji hattara (Danger signs):
- Rufugo iyam ko heewi
- Naawɗi lesdi reedu doole
- Bingel mai anndaa woni (reduced fetal movement) — ɗum tinndina bingel oo woni e caɗeele.

## Ko foti waɗeede (Management):
1. **Yaha sibiti mawnga law-law** (emergency referral) — ndee nge doole waɗtata operation (Cesarean section).
2. **Ngaddan ɓiɗɗo iyam (blood transfusion)** sabu iyam heewi rufii.
3. **Etee IV fluids** ngam wallude balɗe maaru.
4. **Larugo bingel** e ultrasound e monitor ngam anndude woni bingel oo wuuri.

Ndaw caɗeele ɗum foti wallude **debbo e bingel fof**, kanjum ɗum foti yahude **sibiti mawnga** law-law, hade caɗeele ɓeydaade.

question: Likita joɗata ha sare amin lari bingal mako wala mo sungo boddum je o yidi o musina mo sai bingal mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi dada mai bo hirliti bingal mai wala sembe musungo den bo odo vita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso da kanjum tamba denbo fofugo bingal mai.  Demde am, dumedon lattata bingel heba damuwa musungo boddum? No bingel mai foofata do, alaama nyawu fere Donna?  Alaamaji hattara toi daada be baaba mingel mai hokkilinta? Dumedon waatata mingel petel vulungo todo musina?
model_answer:
Njaɓ-mi ɗum. Alaamaaji ɗi a sifiima ɗi—biɗɗo mo suɓataa musinaango, mo woylata sanne, mo waawaa ƴeewtaade wala waawaa muñ'de—ɗi ngoni ma안де alaamaaji **colic** (woyaango biɗɗo mo alaa sabaabu ɓanngu ɗo). 

Kono, ko boɗɗum sanne fii yah'de asibiti, sabu woyaango tiiɗngo waawi hollirde ñawuji goɗɗi tati: **reflux** (kosam ruttotooɗam), **allergie kosam nagge** (allaji ndiyam nagge/formula), maa ñawu nder reedu wala nawnaare wonnde.

Ko foti waɗeede: ndaarnu biɗɗo on asibiti ngam ƴeewtaade so o alaa nawnaare wonnde (ittude coppol maa yiɗeede rawaandu maa ñawu goɗɗo). So o musina, wallu neene on nde o musinta booɗɗum, o ɓorna biɗɗo on doole caggal musinaango ngam yaltina henndu, hokku biɗɗo on jam e ɓernde e junngo, maa ittu njamndi nokku daño.

So biɗɗo on ina yara formula, ƴeewtee waylude nde e formula ndi alaa kosam nagge (lactose-free maa hydrolyzed), sabu ɗum waawi ustude woyaango. So woyaango on ina jokka, ina heewi ɓamtaade, walla biɗɗo on alaa ƴeewtaade maa alaa ƴiwde—yah asibiti law ngam ƴeewtaade tiiɗngo.

Mi faami hakkillo maa e sunaare maa feere ɓinngel maa. Faddaare nde ngaddaa asibiti ndee moƴƴii sanne — ɗum ko golle moƴƴe ngam wallugo cukalel ngel heɓa balndu.

**Ko fotti waɗeede:**
- **Nyaamdu:** Hokku ɓinngel nyaamdu moƴƴuɗo e leemrunde — poroteyin (gawri, ñebbe, kosam, boccooɗe/ganyi, liingu, teewu), e fruits e legumes. Cukalel keewngel nyaamdu moƴƴuɗo ina wanka.
- **Yarugo lekki:** Jokku yarugo lekki ki asibiti hokki on fof no likitaajo wi'iri, taa accu hakkunde.
- **Ruttaango asibiti:** Rutto asibiti no fotiri ngam ɓe ndaara balndu ɓinngel e taari mum (weight monitoring).

Taa hulanaa sanne, kono jokku darnde maa moƴƴere. So a yi'ii ɓinngel ronki nyaamde, ronki ɓamaade, walla naw-ɗum, hooti asibiti law-law.

question: Debbo mo duuɓi caɓɓande tati dayi minti sedda ko sali dango mai dedai ɗon amma daigel ɗo ɓingel ɗo mari damuwaji manga ɓingel ɗo wala woka boɗɗum denbo wala notitta bana keccel waɗata ɓawo dango ɓingel. Ɓingel mai wokai boɗɗum bo ɗo heɓa bone hafinugo ɓandu ɓingel mai ɗo bana ɗo tiddi ko kuma bana wala dimba no handi ɓingel mai wala nyama boɗɗum be torna mum sumungo dada mai ɗo sakri ngam ɓikkoi mako de sali ɗo. Ɗo woka atake to ɓe danyi ɗum waddata damuwa ɗo goji toi be waɗata ɗo keccel ɗo be kuma mataki gawal toi hosata ɗume on wannata ɓingel keccum ɗo.
reference: Debbo mo dubi cappande tati dayi minti sedda ko sali. Dayugo mai daidai don. Amma dai be dayi mingel do, mingel do do Mari damuwaaji manga. Mingel do Wala wooka boddum. Denbo wala nootititta bana kejjel wadata. Bawo dayugo bingel mai wookai  boddum bo do hebba bone ha finigo. Bandu bingel mai do bana do tiddi ko kuma bana walaa dimba no haadi. Bingel mai wala yaama boddum be torna mo musunungo. Daada mai do sakli gam bikkoiji mako de saali do bedo wooka, ataake to be dayibe . Dume don waddata damuwa do? Goji toi be wadata do kechel do, be kuma mataaki gwagaawal toi hosata? Dumedon wannata mingel kejjum do?
model_answer:
**Jaabawol:**

Ndaɗi ɗi debbo mo woni e nder dango tati (30) minti tan e nna ɓingel nyaamataa boɗɗum kaa noon, ɓingel ngel ina foti heɓde balal (danger) mawngal — waɗi noon ko sabu ɓe foti ina heɓi **hypoxia** (ustaare ɗoyre ɗo ɓandu) walla **birth asphyxia** ɗo hakkunde jibinannde.

**Ko foti waɗeede jooni jooni (immediate resuscitation):**
1. **Weeɗ ɓingel** — waɗ ngel e nokkuure weeta, uddu leydi ɗo hunuko e hinere mum (suction) ngam ittude ndiyam maa keccam.
2. **Timmin ɓandu ngel** (dry and keep warm) ngam haɗde ɓuuɓol, sabu ɓikkon keso ina heewi ɓuuɓde law.
3. **So ɓingel foofataa walla foofol mum ustii**, fuɗɗo **foofnude ngel** (rescue breaths) e **jaabtorgal (bag and mask)** so ina heɓee, walla foofnu e hunuko so alaa.
4. **Ƴeew ɓernde** (heart rate) — so ina jaasi 100 e nder minti, jokku foofnugol; so ina jaasi 60, fuɗɗo **fiyde becce** (chest compressions).

**Tawo ɗum:** Yah law law e safrirde walla ballal safaraaji ɓurɗi mawnude (referral) ngam ɓingel keso ngel foti heɓde ballal kesngal e nder saawaaji arande. Ndaɗi ɗi ɓe danyi ɗum, jokkugol foofnugol e newnude ɓuuɓol ko ɗum ɓuri himmude.

question: Debbo ɗo dayi haa amin fajira ɗo veti ɗo o dayi nde o wari jamdi je tati be fajira mo wondi be mako ha sare yani amin vi debbo ɗo ɓandu mako ɗo dimna bo ɗo wuli sosai den bo o do mari damuwaji ko shafi bandu mako je damatamo sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai min suddi mo be kare min auni wolugo ɓandu mako min tawi tati min wanni mo godi je nyamo cufi ngam debbo ɗo velnai o nandi malaria min emi mo ko wondi ko o nyami o vi wala ko oya. Min yecci mo wondi be mako be hokka mo sha’i o yara min emi mo o musini handi na sai o vi de o wari mo sungo ɓingel mai sai o tawi keccel mai riwi se min vi debbo mai o umma o joɗa o ɓari ɓawo mako. Babal vallita ɓandu mako hoina seɗɗa ɗo pat nda pat ba amma vallitai bo gite mako laɓin sari mo to nyami ni sai o yara parasita mol to yari parasita mol mai timmi sei min lara dai on handi min hokka mo fahin o ɗo mari malaria ko ma min waɗi mogoji mai us min hokka mo o timmini nyamugo nden bo min sari mo o yara parasita mo tonda o satai to dillai min handi nyau min hokka mo min hokkata.
reference:
Debbo do dayi ha amin fajira do. Veeti do o dayi. Dai owari jambi je tati be fajiri , mo wondi be mako ha sare yooni amin, vi debbo do bandu mako do duina bo do vuli sosai denbo odo mari damuwaaji ko shafi bandu mako je daamata sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai, min suddi mo be kare, mi hauni wulugo bandu mako, min tawi 38.2.
Min wanni mo goji be nawu chufi. Kam debbo do velnai, o nandi malariya . Min emmi mo ko woodi ko o yaami, ovi wala ko Oyami. Min yechi mo vondi be mako, be hokkamo shaa’i o yara. Min emmimo o musini hande na? Sai ovi dai owari musungo bingel mai, sai o tawi kecchel mai riiwi.
Sai minvi debbo mai o umma o hoods obaara bawo mako , heba vallita bandu mako hoina sedda da pat ba, amma vallitai bo gite mako Labai. Min sauri mo to yamini sai oyara paracetamol. To oyari paracetamol mai timmi , sai min lara dai don haadi minhokka mo fein. Odo mari malayria kuma min wani mo goji mai . Useni min waawanmihokka mo fein. To o timmini yamugo, denbo min sauri mo o yara paracetamol, tunda o saatai, to dillai ni minhandai yaudinde min hokkata.
model_answer:
Ndarial am e ngal windannde maa, hida faama debbo ɗo o wondi e balɗe ɗiɗi malaria e nawnaare ɓandu. Ono woodi ko haani heɓde reenugo:

**1. Ƴeewndo caɗeele mawɗe (Danger signs):** Ono haani ƴeewde so debbo ɗo ina waawi yarude e nyaamude, walla ina mari ɓaƴgol, ɓaleeje, doole ustaade, walla toɓɓe. So o waawaa yarude walla ina wullita, ono foti neldeede to nokku mo mari doole ɓurɗe (referral).

**2. Malaria kesuɗo:** Wonaa e nokkeele Naajeeriya, ono haani hokkude ACT (Artemisinin-based Combination Therapy) hono Artemether-Lumefantrine so tan test malaria (RDT) hollii ko woodi. So debbo ɗo waawaa yarude, ono foti hokkeede Artesunate lekki (injection).

**3. Ndaarugo ndiyam:** Ƴeewndo so o ɓoyi ndiyam (dehydration) sabu ɗo wuli, ono haani hokkeede ORS walla drip so o waawaa yarude.

**4. Ƴeewndo goɗɗum:** Wonaa tan malaria — ɗo wuli sanne e ɓandu muusaa ina waawi wonde typhoid, UTI, walla nawnaare goɗɗo, ono foti waɗde test ɓe ɓureewol e widto so ina hasii.

Mi wiimaa yahdu e mo to safrirde mawnde so caɗeele ɗe ɓeydaki, sabu hoore muusaa e ɓandu wulɗo balɗe ɗiɗi ina waawi wonde nawnaare mawnde.

Mi hokkete jaabuye e ɗe naamnde:

**Waɗde ɓinngel woytaaki gila danaango:** Ɓinngel mo woytaaki e nder minti sappo caka danaango, e ɓaawo mum tampere e teentungol, ina waawi tinaade wolde e "birth asphyxia" (ronkere ɓinngel heɓde henndu no haani e sahaa danaango). model_answer:
**Jaabawol:**

Alamaji ɗe dada wi'i—iyam ka duuɓe (lochia) je vurtata ɓawo danyugo, ɓingel mo o mari kadi mo mari vodai (jaundice/kesol), be tampol mako be munyaari ka ɓandu mako—ko alamaji je hanndude reftol likita, wanaa haala je waɗeten sai be munyaani.

**Ko mi wi'ata:**
1. Iyam je vurtata ɓawo danyugo (lochia) ko hunde je feƴƴata ha balɗe 4-6, kono to ɗum ɗuuɗi walla to o mari uddu bonɗo, ko alama bone (postpartum hemorrhage walla infection) je hanndi reftol asibiti law.
2. Kesol ɓingel (neonatal jaundice) to ɓe tokka, ko waawi bonugo ha hakkille ɓinngel—hanndi ɓe yaha asibiti ngam ɓe ndaara iyam mako be ɓe ndokka ɓe safaara (phototherapy) to hanndi.
3. Dada je tampi, je alkasi be munyaari ka ɓandu, ko waawi wonugo anaemia (asewre ƴiiƴam) walla infection, ɗum kadi hanndi reftol likita.
4. Mi wi'a dada nde ta munyu—yaha asibiti law ngam ɓe ndaara mo be ɓinngel mako, sabu ɗee alamaji ko waawi wonugo je haɗata yontere to ɓe kokki safaara.
5. Sanaji je ndiyam (traditional/spiritual remedies) waawaa lomtinde safaara likita e ndee saa'i, hanndi reftol asibiti ngam danygol dada be ɓinngel.

Mi yiɗi wallude, kono mi anndaa no feewi ko a wi'ata. Naamnal maa nanngataa laabi feewi—ɗum waɗii caɗeele e nanndugo maanaa mum.

# Nafarki Debbo Rufoowo Iyam (Postpartum Hemorrhage)

Ndee jamre ko haala **rufugo iyam ko ɓura keerol ɓaawo jibinugo (Postpartum Hemorrhage)**, ko woni musiiba mawɗo e nder sibiti, ɓe foti hentaade law-law.

**Ko foti waɗeede jaka:**

1. **Massage Uterus** – Ɗabbaade reedu debbo (fundus) e junngo, saka'u no yaawi fii yo reedu 'e hoora, sabu ko heewi rufugo iyam ummii e reedu ndu waɗtaani hoorde.

2. **Lekkiiji darnayɗi iyam** – Rokku **Oxytocin (10 IU IM/IV)** ko woni lekki gadanki; so alaa maa yonaani, rokku **Misoprostol (800mcg)** walla **Ergometrine** (so debbo alaa ñaw ɓernde/hypertension).

3. **Yonki (fluids)** – Habbir laawol ɗiɗi (IV lines) mawɗi, rokku **Normal Saline walla Ringer's Lactate** law fii yo yiiyam mum artu, saka'u eɓɓu **iyam heɓaneede (blood transfusion)** so debbo ustii yiiyam sanne.

4. **Ndaaru sabaabu:** Ndaaru so tawii jibinaani fof (retained placenta), walla ɓoli 'e leyɗe jibinirde ɓoli (vaginal/cervical tear) yo mooɓe, sabu ɗiin no rufina iyam.

Roƴu debbo o sibiti mawɗo (referral) so lekkiiji e katanɗe alaa e sibiti maa, sabu ndee jamre no wara law.

Nawnaare ndee no wa'i wa **anemia mawnde (severe anemia)** je ɗon habda be dama mai (malaria) e nawnaare ummii be redu. Ɓeydari sembe iyam (blood transfusion) bee lekki dama no boɗɗum, ammaa ko ɓuri himmude, ɗum ɗon foti yeecude sabaabu maggo: yara hundeji fere (fatigue), uppa yeeso (facial swelling), namuki hore, e bandu fu hoore-nawnaare — ɗum fuu ina holla anemia ummi be nawnaare mawnde wolla nawnaare ɓernde.

Kala ɗum ɗon hollira e wonde ndiyam ɗam njaraɗon-ɗon ɗam **wonaa laaɓɗam** — ɗam ina wondi e kulle (bacteria) walla dabbaaji tokoosi (parasites) ɗi ndaɗanta ñawu.

**Ko waɗi ma nana e bandu maa:**
- **Dogugol reedu (diarrhea)** e **ɓodugol/naftaari** — ɗum foti addude **noppitaare ndiyam (dehydration)**, ɓee tampere, jaggol, e nanugol jangol ko wonande yeeso maa.
- **Naftaari e semmbe** — ina foti wonde ñawu reedu (typhoid, cholera, walla giardia/amoeba).

**Ko mbaɗataa jooni:**
1. **Yiwu tan ndiyam laaɓɗam** — fatt ndiyam ɗam (buƴƴin ha ɗam wuli minit 5–10) walla huutoro filter/klorin.
2. **Yaru ORS (ndiyam koɓɓal)** — waɗ litar ndiyam laaɓɗam, kuɗe suukara 6, e teemedere-feccere lamɗam, njaraa haa dogugol ustii.
3. **Yah safirteeɓe/sibiti law** — ɓe ndaɗta test reedu e ɓiɗɗam ngam anndude si ko typhoid, cholera walla parasite, ɓe okka ma safaari feewnooru.

**Nyaawu ngu debbo redu ɗo heɓi ngu ko "palpitations" e "shortness of breath" (ɓernde fiyugo law law e uppugo dande), nyaawu ngu foti ka ɗum jibaru redu (anemia) mo heewi e rewɓe redu ɓe.** Debbo redu na foti heɓa ɗiiɗi ƴiiƴam (increased blood volume) e wonugo yeeso ɓinngel, ɗum addata palpitations e nayeere (fatigue).

**Kono, alaamaaji o siftini ɗi—ɓernde fiyugo law, uppugo dande, satugo satiji, e ronkugo huutorgo jungo—foti ko alamaaji ɓurɗi bonugo wano hypertension (ɓalɗe ƴiiƴam ɓeydaade) walla ɓernde nawnaare (heart disease).** Ɗum ne foti anndinta wonugo "pre-eclampsia" so tawii ɓalɗe ƴiiƴam ɓeydike e proteins ɗon e cottol, ɗum ko caɗeele mawɗe e redu.

**Ko moƴƴi ko yaagol law law to safrirde ngam likita ɗaɓɓita ɓalɗe ƴiiƴam (blood pressure), ƴiiƴam (blood count/PCV), e cottol, ngam anndude ko addi alaamaaji ɗi e safrude ɗum law.** Wata a haɗtin—alaamaaji redu ɗi na foti wonude caɗeele ɓurɗi mawnude nde tawii safaara heɓaaki law.

**Ndu rawandu wanngii mo, ɗum ko rabies (rawandu maayo/kuutorwuru) himmani no feewi.**

Sabu ndu rawandu ngatii bingel, jonta babal ngati ngal fuɗɗii ɓurtaade e wuurtaade ɗum tinndinta ko **rabies** — nawnaare warayɗe nde alaa safaara so tampere maayre nde fuɗɗike (hydrophobia, ɓurtaade babal, seytaare). So maayo maayii, alaa ko wonata safaara, ɓiɗɗo maayan.

**Ko foti waɗeede jonta jonta:**
1. **Loota babal ngal e ndiyam e saabunle** ñalawma sappo e joweeɗiɗi (15 minutes), ɗum ustay virus ɗen.
2. **Naɓee bingel asibiti law law** ngam heɓa **rabies vaccine (PEP)** e **anti-rabies immunoglobulin (RIG)** — ɗum woni safaara mo hisinta.
3. Yalta ha lekki fere; safaara laaɓɗo ko asibiti tan.

**Rawandu ndu ngoodi:** so wawi heɓeede, jogaa ndu (quarantine) balɗe sappo ngam ndaaree so ndu maayan — ammaa ɗum wallataa gaddaade naɓugol bingel asibiti jonta jonta.

**Hujja:** So seytaare (symptoms) fuɗɗike e ɓiɗɗo, safaara alaa. Ko vaccine ndeen jaɓoowo ado nawnaare fuɗɗaade woni ko hisinta yonki mum.

question: Debbo darnajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako de o lari zazzabi nangi gal mai non non tan fuɗɗi dimbugo bingal mai do wada jinl wala der hakkilo irin nyautoi hebi bingel dadalgu sumdo be irin hakkulungo hakkilinta bingal do.

model_answer:
Ndaa noone mi faami naamngal maa: Debbo darnjo (juuɗiiɗo/reedu) mo woni e zazzabi (feebru), refi non ɓernde mum fuɗɗi dimbaade, hakkilo mum wayli, wonaa hoɗi e hakkiilo laaɓngo — ɗum tinndina eclampsia.

**Ko foti waɗeede jaka:**
1. **Magnesium sulfate** ko lekki ɓurngi moƴƴude ngam haɗde/dartinde jinl (convulsions) — ko ɗum lekki gadiingi.
2. Ustu tampere (blood pressure) e lekki wa'i no **hydralazine** walla **labetalol** so tampere ɓuri 160/110.
3. Reena laawol henndu (airway), rokku oxygen, hisnu debbo o hokku ka o waasa yanude walla barmaade.
4. **Ko ɓuri himmude:** ummin debbo o yaha suudu safaraaji timmuɗi (referral) law-law ngam jibinngo ɓinngel ngel — ko jibinal tan safrata eclampsia haqiiqa.

Waɗ ɗum law sabu eclampsia ina wara neɗɗo e ɓinngel mum so safaaki law.

Woodi ko ɓuri himmude: bingel wawaa nyaamde e ronki yara fu, ɗum wonan ﻣﻮﺗﻮﮐﻮ ﻣﺎﻭﻧﺪﻭ, ﺳﺎﺑﺎﺑﺎ o waawi heɓde **danndaare ɗiyam (dehydration)** e wattidde nguru kaɓaru.

Miɗo wi'a ma: **hoto ɗaɓɓaa safaari gargajiya (safarhoore aduna) walla nyaamirde nyauɗe ganndi**, sabu ɗum ɓeydan nyawu ngu tan e waawi wonde ﻟﻮﺭﺍ e beeɗu (hunduko puuɗam) e liver bingel oo.

Ɓingel maa (dubi jui e lebbi ɗiɗi) heɓi **doole nyawu ɗo tuutugol e ɓernde saɗtude jemma e nyalooma**, ɗum ko maande nyawu tiiɗngu wonande ɓinganel warano. Kono maande **teddunde** (danger signs) ko: ɓingel salaade njaram fof, tuutugol fof ko ndokku-ɗaa (kala huunde), wojjere e kaake, hoore-ɗaa saɗtude, gilogol ko ɓuri saawaaji jeetati (8 hours) walla enɗi weeba nde hunduko heewi jareede.

Mi wiyi maa **hollu ɓingel maa hospital ɗoo law-law** (ndaartu emergency), sabu ɓinganel warano jaram maggel yaawan yeewande so hono saɗtii, ɗum na waawi wadde deshydratation e naɓde nguru ballal.

Ɗoo hospital, be njaɓan ɓingel maa **njaram njaram e ɗaɗi (IV fluids/drip)** so o waawaa yara e hunduko, be njaɓan ɓe safaara maande nyawu ngu (tibi hono ORS walla safaara goɗɗo), gila ɓe njaɓan e ndokku njaram ORS seeɗa-seeɗa so tuutugol dartii.

# Jaabawol

Wakkati fofugo ɓinngel wartay dede ɓaawo danyeenugo, ɗum firti hooto **fofuki hakkillaaji ndeenka** (birth asphyzia/perinatal asphyxia) ndi waɗi ɓinngel heɓɓaali sembe (oksijan) haa hakkille to o danyaa.

Ko boɗɗum wakkati fu jokku ɓinngel to sibiti do jaɓɓowo ɓikkoy (SCBU/NICU) si woodi, ngam ndeenka oksijan, tempretur, njameeje e caltuɗi hakkille.
